summary: Trace each conflicting change to its purpose, preserve compatible behavior, and complete the operation without sweeping unrelated work into the commit.

supporting_disposition.reason: Preserve source UI metadata and invocation policy exactly.
Retain Matt Pocock MIT attribution in every refactored package.

deltas.change: Inventory operation state and pre-existing changes before editing.
deltas.reason: A conflict resolver needs to know which operation and changes it owns.
deltas.tradeoff: A short state check precedes resolution.

deltas.change: Use three-way content and primary intent, with explicit rebase-side semantics.
deltas.reason: Ours/theirs labels can mislead during replay and do not establish intent.
deltas.tradeoff: History reading may take longer than mechanical marker deletion.

deltas.change: Pause only genuinely incompatible, unresolved intent rather than inventing behavior.
deltas.reason: Always resolve cannot justify choosing an unstated product goal.
deltas.tradeoff: Some conflicts remain pending a decision.

deltas.change: Stage only resolved operation-owned changes, not everything.
deltas.reason: Unrelated local edits can otherwise be committed accidentally.

deltas.change: Preserve no-abort default while allowing explicit user cancellation.
deltas.reason: Persistence is appropriate until the user changes the goal.
deltas.tradeoff: The absolute source prohibition becomes scoped to the authorized operation.
